author: reginwel
quote: Not doing a simultaneous launch for the biggest entertainment release in the industry just so they can resell the better version months later is the greediest and sole reasonable justification for giving this game my score. I don't care much about the story, considering the writer who made GTA what it is has left, but getting spoiled is still frustrating. So even when it eventually comes to PC, I'll still rate it lower than it deserves. And I assure you, what it deserves is not a 10.
